title: výběr hovorů podle pravidel ČSOB
interface: final class Drupal\csobrec\Service\Selection, no constructor arguments. Method select(array $calls, array $modes): array takes Call objects and a map 'queue number' => QueueMode and returns Item objects. A queue missing from $modes is ignored entirely. QueueMode::All takes every call of that queue. QueueMode::Logic takes a call whose disposition is '[CSOB] Nový prodej' or '[CSOB] Nový prodej TZ', and every call of the SAME phone number in the SAME queue whose time is earlier or equal — later calls are not part of that history. The same activity id must yield one line even when it appears twice in the input. Each selected call yields Item(call, call->policyNumber, 1); when the call has xSell TRUE and a non-empty xSellNumber it yields a second Item(call, xSellNumber, 2). The result is sorted by time, then activity, then copy. Pure function: it must not modify the input array or the Call objects.
